import json, subprocess, sys

def run(payload):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'submission/main.py'], input=payload,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/workspace')
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode().strip()

def route(i):  # /128 at address i
    return [format(i, 'x') + '::/128', 1]

def mk(initial, transactions):
    return json.dumps({'cases': [{'initial': initial, 'transactions': transactions,
                                  'bursts': [], 'cache_pages': 1,
                                  'costs': {'hit':1,'miss':1,'decode':[0,0,0]}}]}).encode()

# 63 routes at keys 0..62 -> exactly 64 runs: valid
print('R=64 exact:', run(mk([route(i) for i in range(63)], []))[1][:60])
# 64 routes at keys 0..63 -> 65 runs: invalid
print('R=65 exact:', run(mk([route(i) for i in range(64)], []))[1][:60])
# 4 versions x 32 runs = 128 total: valid (31 routes -> 32 runs)
tx3 = [[['erase', format(i, 'x') + '::/128']] for i in range(3)]
print('sum=128 exact:', run(mk([route(i) for i in range(31)], tx3))[1][:60])
# 4 versions x 33 runs = 132: invalid (32 routes -> 33 runs)

req['cases'][1]['initial'] = [[format(i, 'x') + '::/128', 1] for i in range(16, 32)]
